requirement: Reviews with a rating of 1 or 2 should automatically open a case for the merchant success team.
hidden_intent: Record-triggered flow on Review create: if Rating <= 2, create a Case linked to the Storefront and the reviewing Contact, assigned to the Merchant Success queue, subject including the storefront name. Only on create, not on edits.

expect.notes: After-save flow on Review__c; Case already has Storefront__c lookup to reuse; avoid duplicate cases on edits; route to an existing queue rather than inventing one.
